reviews.text:
Welcoming, polite staff.
Been visiting for almost 20 years.
The best vets there is. Would recommend anyone to take their pets here. The vets truly care about the animals they treat.
Friendly staff, geeat help in every way, puts your mind at ease as soon as you walk in

Although quite expensive, their charges are reasonable compared to other private vets in the area. The staff and vets are friendly, cheerful and take time to explain everything.

I brought in a little feral cat I befriended to be neutered and to have his shots, and they were very kind to him.

Costs were:
Neutering: £90
Vaccinations (1st of 2 rounds): £85
Microchip implant: £29.50

One word of warning, they will put a chip on your pet for a fee, but in order to make it useful you have to pay a subscription, which can be anywhere from £15-£40/year.
The staff in the lodge veterinary are an amazing, professional and very helpful
Did a great job treating my fur baby. Reassuring and friendly x
Popped in for a prescription for lily one of our springers, lovely staff always happy to help.

I have been a customer of the lodge veterinary centre for over thirty years, I visit the practice at least twice a week and I have not one single complaint about their service to my family and I and ultimately my pets who they care for..
I have to say both Fintan and Catherine are exceptional senior vets , Catherine and her diligence have allowed me to have a further two and a half years with my beautiful dog Paddy due to her methodical approach in spotting his cancer very early on from a particle that had started to grow again ,after the first surgery he had already had to remove his anal gland’s previously.
I also had a Persian cat called Milly who had a tumour in the back of her eye, again that Catherine spotted and was able to be removed without me incurring huge referral vet fees at another surgery by Catherine.
Catherine is always about the patient and they are always at the forefront in her medical care this is something I find very comforting to know especially as a person who is very pro animal rights over anything else.
When the time came for Paddy to go across the rainbow bridge, the empathy and compassion I received from Catherine and Kayleigh the veterinary care assistant was second to none, and the professional advice given to me very much helped in my decision making process to allow my dog Paddy to become pain free.
Fintan the vet is just a joy, not only is he an exceptional dentist and has kept my cat who is now tooth free and pain free alive for a further fifteen years and is now at the tender age of 19 years old and living her best life thanks to Fintan.
Most recently Fintan has removed over 16 teeth, my rescue dog suzie and also took her out of a large amount of immeasurable pain when with his attention to detail noticed a fistula in the root of her mouth to her nose and fixed this immediately.
Thanks to Fintan suzie is now pain free. Fintan also is very knowledgeable on all aspects of veterinary care, but if you aren’t sure about something he will explain clearly to you or give you one of his famous diagrams on his white board. 😊
Lauren and Dominic are also both fantastic vets and have been instrumental in keeping my animals healthy and alive.
Then we have lovely Louise the receptionist not only is she a pleasure to see when you first enter the reception, but she also shows genuine care and compassion to customers especially when you have just lost a loved on.
The nurses and the care staff are also all very friendly and supportive whenever I go into the practice.
Stacy, Kayleigh, Kelly, Holly, Megan, Vicky and not forgetting Kim are all a great asset to this practice.
From my experience I would not recommend anywhere else to have your animals to be treated, and I still currently have five more fur babies on there register so I am sure I will be regularly visiting the practice.
A five star recommendation does not speak highly enough for this practice and there members of staff.
The Vet and nurses very friendly.
Really dislike this place expensive and pdsa is a lot better cost this place more
I take all my cats/kittens here. Great place!

So patient and caring

They nursed my little chihuahua called Dadyal Kashmiri back to health

Thank you all especially FinTan
Great vet always helpful! Boris my dog loves them

These are the best vets out there.
I have always used these vets for many years and i trust them with my dog.
Dont go anywhere else
I decided to take my dog to a closer vets as she had a lump come up on her eye I thought it was just a bite and some eye drops and antibiotics would do the trick how wrong was I.

The vets told me she needed an operation and would cost me over 2k I was not happy as they never even examined her properly.
So I decided I wanted a 2nd option so back to the lodge I went i should have come here in the 1st place.

They fully examined her yes she needed an operation but it wasn't as bad as the other vets made out.
They checked her over made sure she was fit for the operation as she is an old girl. Understanding all the risk with her operation but also reassuring that she was healthy.
I booked her in for the next day the operation went extremely well and I have a very happy dog again with a huge saving as this only cost £700.

The lodge are not money greedy or think everyone has insurance so they can rip you off.
they truly care for your pets you can see they love animals.

Thank you too your team.
Amazing vets.
